lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Engineer · PM-2.4
lesson_intro.board_text:
Troubleshooting Connectivity
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Timeout tickets are network until proven otherwise.

Mental model:
Path: SG → NACL → route → subnet → reachability.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: I am Ren. Timeout tickets are network until proven otherwise. Mental model: Path: SG → NACL → route → subnet → reachability. I demonstrate, then you practice. Least privilege and Region discipline stay non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
